people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

translations.web: “Come,” they say, “let’s destroy them as a nation, that the name of Israel may be remembered no more.”
translations.bsb: saying, “Come, let us erase them as a nation; may the name of Israel be remembered no more.”
translations.kjv: They have said, Come, and let us cut them off from being a nation; that the name of Israel may be no more in remembrance.
translations.asv: They have said, Come, and let us cut them off from being a nation; That the name of Israel may be no more in remembrance.
